expectedUsable: When the user adds the mug to the cart, a screen reader announces the confirmation ("Added 1 to cart...") without the user having to move focus to find it.

violations.expectedFix: Give the confirmation container a live region: role="status" (or aria-live="polite") so the injected text is announced automatically. The element must exist in the DOM before the update.
violations.notes: The add-to-cart confirmation is injected into a plain <div> with no aria-live/role=status. Sighted users see it; screen-reader users hear nothing. No axe rule requires status messages, so the page is clean.
